description: This file declares classes and functions related to UDP socket operations on Windows, including socket management, QoS (QWAVE) integration, DSCP handling, and multicast options within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: QwaveApi
classes.description: Manages Windows QWAVE API functions for setting packet priorities and QoS flows.

classes.name: DscpManager
classes.description: Handles setting DSCP values per remote endpoint using QWAVE flows on Windows.

classes.name: UDPSocketWin
classes.description: Encapsulates UDP socket operations on Windows, including connect, bind, read, write, multicast, and QoS management.

methods.name: QwaveApi
methods.description: Constructor, deletion, and static getter for default instance; methods to check support and manage QoS flows.

methods.name: DscpManager
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, Set, and PrepareForSend methods for managing DSCP values and remote addresses.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and methods for socket operations: Open, Bind, Connect, Close, GetPeerAddress, GetLocalAddress, Read, Write, RecvFrom, SendTo, and configuration options.
